messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate detected on /v1/generate in prod. Routing fallback loop suspected (smart-routing). Paging @maria (oncall) and @eng-runtime.

maria: on it. acked pager. seeing spike from 03:12 UTC onward. 5xxs -> 502/503, and a bunch of routing logs that show repeated cross-region handoffs. attaching quick head-> tail examples.

ajay: any customer-facing alerts fired?

support-bot: FYI: Customers with active Dedicated capacity flagged errors: acme-inc, beta-saas, and partner-x. Support is collecting IDs.

sasha: I can pull runtime traces. early hypothesis: fallback policy is bouncing between region eu-west-1 and us-west-2 because the model variant tagged for eu-west is marked incompatible for tool-calling in the compatibility matrix, so requests fall back to us-west, which then falls back back to eu-west due to capacity heuristics. loop.

maria: logs snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T03:12:11Z route=eu-west-1 -> model=redwood/gpt-qa-quant-v2 status=ERR incompatible-toolcall
2026-03-15T03:12:11Z fallback-> us-west-2 route=us-west-2 -> model=redwood/gpt-qa-fp16 status=ERR ctx-too-long
2026-03-15T03:12:11Z fallback-> eu-west-1 route=eu-west-1 -> model=redwood/gpt-qa-quant-v2 status=ERR incompatible-toolcall
```

kevin: that matches an issue I saw earlier in model-onboarding: the compatibility matrix entry for `gpt-qa-quant-v2` erroneously listed `tool_calling: true` but the quantized build does not include the tool signatures (we didn't strip ckpt metadata). so runtime rejects with an incompatibility error and routing tries another variant.

sasha: the problem is compounded by our routing policy: `prefer_region_then_cost` has a fallback set `max_hops: 5` but also `prefer_alternate_region: true`. combined with continuous capacity changes it keeps flipping.

maria: immediate mitigation proposals: (1) disable cross-region fallback in routing policy (set prefer_alternate_region:false) (2) mark the quant variant as non-tool-calling in registry to stop the compatibility check fail path, (3) push a hotfix to the runtime to short-circuit loop detection (stop after 1 cross-region hop). which one should we do now?

ajay: do 1 + 2 now. 3 is code change and requires release. 1 is config change, quick to roll. 2 is registry flag flip, also quick.

nora: I'm ready to make the config change. will update the routing policy in console and pin a fallback to same-region-preferred. keeping a 10m window for rollback.

deploy-bot: :rocket: config change queued: routing-policy/prefer_region_then_cost -> prefer_alternate_region=false by nora. Change will no longer allow cross-region fallback for 10m window.

maria: flipped. monitoring.

support-bot: support note: impacted customers see ~30% error rate on generation endpoints starting 03:12 UTC, volume concentrated on eu-west-1. no data exfiltration indicators. customer notifications drafted.

kevin: I also updated model-registry: set `tool_calling: false` for redwood/gpt-qa-quant-v2 and added a note `temp-marked-no-toolcall: true`. this prevents runtime from routing to quant variant for tool-calling requests.

maria: after changes we're seeing errors drop to 2-4% and latency stabilized. some requests still fail due to ctx-length mismatches when fallback picked fp16 variant — that's separate.

sasha: capturing a minimal repro log: user request with tool_calling=true + prompt length 28k tokens. routing attempted quant (no toolcall support) -> fp16 (ctx limit 16k) -> dropped. So two compatibility dimensions at play: tool_calling support and context length.

ajay: customer impact assessment: 3 enterprise customers with active sessions affected (ACME, Beta-SaaS, Partner-X). Estimated affected requests ~4.2k over 25 minutes. SLA breach window ~03:12-03:40 UTC.

maria: handing off to next oncall @kevin for post-incident follow through. I will remain available for the postmortem.

kevin: ack. next steps I'm logging:
- short term: keep prefer_alternate_region=false until compatibility fixes are rolled out (owner: nora)
- medium term: add model-registry validation that denies tool_calling=true for quantized builds unless signature present (owner: kevin/eng-ml)
- medium term: routing engine change to add loop protection and hop-count enforcement (owner: sasha/eng-runtime)
- customer followup: support to send targeted incident emails and credit usage (owner: support)

maria: tagging followups in tracker: INF-6421 (compatibility validation), INF-6422 (routing-loop protection), INF-6423 (add e2e test for tool-calling + quantized matrix).

support-bot: customer notification sent to ACME and Beta-SaaS. Partner-X on phone.

kevin: retaining this thread for the postmortem. will create timeline and attach logs. thanks all for quick response. :white_check_mark:

maria: closing pager now. please add any late notes to this thread and I'll copy into the postmortem doc.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Error rate returned to baseline. Duration: ~28m. Severity: Sev2.
